detailed_descriptions.en: Catch Meow if You Can is a chaotic co-op survival game where you play as the real owners of the house: the cats. A crew of thieves breaks into your home not for gold, but for you. Play solo or with up to 4 friends. Hide in the shadows, squeeze through tight spaces, climb higher floors, and complete objectives to unlock your path upward. Each level forces you to outsmart the thieves as you slip past them and push closer to freedom. Complete Ratjoe’s tasks by collecting and delivering the items he asks for without missing a single objective. If you fulfill all his requests, he will help you escape upward through five increasingly dangerous floors. Face different types of enemies, each with unique behaviors and mechanics that change how you play. Some hunt aggressively, some set traps, and others try to flush you out of hiding. Every encounter forces you to adapt, rethink your strategy, and use the environment in new ways. Use throwable items together to turn the odds in your favor. Stun and temporarily disable thieves to help your teammates escape, rescue them from danger, or buy valuable time to complete objectives. detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Catch Meow if You Can is a chaotic co-op survival game where you play as the real owners of the house: the cats. A crew of thieves breaks into your home not for gold, but for you.

        Play solo or with up to 4 friends. Hide in the shadows, squeeze through tight spaces, climb higher floors, and complete objectives to unlock your path upward. Each level forces you to outsmart the thieves as you slip past them and push closer to freedom.

        Complete Ratjoe’s tasks by collecting and delivering the items he asks for without missing a single objective. If you fulfill all his requests, he will help you escape upward through five increasingly dangerous floors.

        Face different types of enemies, each with unique behaviors and mechanics that change how you play. Some hunt aggressively, some set traps, and others try to flush you out of hiding. Every encounter forces you to adapt, rethink your strategy, and use the environment in new ways.

        Use throwable items together to turn the odds in your favor. Stun and temporarily disable thieves to help your teammates escape, rescue them from danger, or buy valuable time to complete objectives.

  • Online co op and offline single player

  • Proximity voice chat for chaotic coordination

  • Different types of enemies with unique mechanics

  • Objective based progression with Ratjoe quests

  • Throwable items to stun and slow down thieves

  • Environmental hazards and interactive traps

  • Different Cat skins

  • Spectate mode after getting caught
